## Question

What question does this PR answer?

## Hypothesis

What do we believe will improve?

## Minimal change

Why is this the smallest coherent implementation?

## Evidence

What reproducible tests or experiments support it?

## Falsifier

What result would show this approach is wrong?

## Cost

Record development and evaluation resources consumed.

## Complexity delta

List concepts, dependencies, configuration, and persistent state added.

## Reversibility

How can this change be removed or rolled back?

## New knowledge

What did we learn regardless of the merge decision?
